origin: Named after the memory experiments of the German psychologist Hedwig von Restorff in 1933. It's also called the isolation effect.
whenToUse: You mark the recommended plan or option.
You make an important warning or new feature stand out in a list.
You set the main button apart from secondary ones.
whenNotToUse: You'd emphasize several at once (nothing stands out).
You'd make the option that's bad for people stand out.
You'd distinguish it by color alone.
